videos.headline: Robinson to Carey, out Caught by Buttler!! Scant consolation for England. A faint tickle and Carey is gone. The away-seamer on a good length, across Carey who pokes and edges. Clear edge and umpire Rod Tucker has the finger up. Reward for Robinson with Australia just 4 away. Carey c Buttler b Robinson 9(23)

Green to Woakes, out Caught by Carey!! 138.3kph. England are bowled out! Shortish ball, Woakes backs away to ramp it over the cordon and nicks it through to the keeper. Fifth catch for Carey in this innings. Woakes c Carey b Green 16(47) [4s-2]

Lyon to Mark Wood, out Bowled!! Loads of flight, bowls it very full, drawing the tail-ender forward. The ball drifts in and it's actually a half-volley. Wood gets forward to drive and misses it altogether. Gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball cannons onto the off-stump. Mark Wood b Lyon 6(13) [4s-1]

Lyon to Robinson, out Caught by Head!! Robinson brings out the reverse sweep and finds backward point. 86.6kph, offie on off and middle, Robinson plays a risky shot and fails to keep it down. More off the top-edge. Head moves to his right to snaffle it with both hands. Third wicket for Lyon and he's a happy man. Robinson c Head b Lyon 8(17)

Hazlewood to Buttler, out Caught by Carey!! 132kph, nicked and gone! Pokes at a wide-ish ball and it's a straightforward catch for the keeper. Short of a good length, hint of away-seam movement around the sixth stump region. Buttler stays in his crease and fiddle at it well outside his body. Catching practice for the 'keeper. Seven down and England still trail by 10 runs! Buttler c Carey b Hazlewood 23(39) [4s-3]

Cummins to Stokes, out Caught by Green!! Gone! Brings himself into the attack and he gets the important wicket. A shuffling Stokes looks to turn this length ball into the on-side and gets into an awkward position. It seamed away with a bit of extra bounce and Stokes got into a tangle. He was squared up, closed his bat-face early and the back leg was in the air. Ugly looking. The ball takes the leading edge and Green gobbles it up at gully moving to his left. Stokes c Green b Cummins 14(49) [4s-3]

Lyon to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Smith!! Oh dear, after all the fight shown yesterday, England are tumbling now. Lyon again. Kicks up off a length at Pope as he looks to cut. Turn, bounce, cramps him up for room and pops off the glove to first slip. Ollie Pope c Smith b Lyon 4(6) [4s-1]

Green to Root, out Caught by Carey!! Oh Australia have got Root as well. Body blow for England as the captain feathers an outswinger to the keeper. Good length ball around the fifth stump, Green gets it to shape away nicely while drawing Root forward in defence. He was probably looking to play with an open face there, rather than a straight bat. Results in a faint nick to the keeper. Australia couldn't have asked for a better start. Both Malan and Root gone before the new ball becomes due. Root c Carey b Green 89(165) [4s-10]

Lyon to Malan, out Caught by Labuschagne!! Lyon finally has wicket no.400 after waiting almost a whole year for it. And it's a massive wicket as he breaks the partnership. That fielder at silly mid-off which he got in for Malan right from the start today does the trick. Malan steps out, isn't to the pitch, tries to defend but it pops up after taking a thick inside edge onto pad. Labuschagne is alert to it. Takes it nicely to his left. Australia have the opening they wanted. Malan c Labuschagne b Lyon 82(195) [4s-10]

Starc to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Carey!! And out of nowhere Haseeb Hameed is strangled down leg. Hameed walks distraught. Nothing short of length delivery down leg, Hameed contrives to glove+feather it fine to Carey. Immediately everyone knew there was a deflection and no need for the review either. After a poor over, Hameed gets out. He was looking so good and has got out after a start. Pressure on Root next. Haseeb Hameed c Carey b Starc 27(58) [4s-4]

Cummins to Rory Burns, out Caught by Carey!! That's the end of Rory Burns. Fantastic delivery to get the opener too. Dug in short and across Burns, it bounces from that length and catches Burns unawares, the speed gun shows 135kph, but it definitely looked quicker than that, catches the glove as Burns shapes to cut and flies to Carey who takes it. Definitely jumped from the pitch and brushes the glove - gave Burns no chance on the shot. A wicket in the first over after lunch. Rory Burns c Carey b Cummins 13(27) [4s-2]

Mark Wood to Head, out Bowled!! Makes a lot of room, Wood responds with a cracking yorker on middle stump and Head fails to keep it out. A superb innings from Head comes to an end and it's the end of the Australian innings as well. Head b Mark Wood 152(148) [4s-14 6s-4]

Robinson to Green, out Bowled!! Bowled 'im. Two in two for Robinson and England roaring back after Tea. The inangler from Robinson, jags back in sharply at 128kph, Green shoulders arms and sees the ball come in to hit off-stump. Green did not cover the off-stump and allowed the ball a free passage. Robinson now on a hat-trick and the Barmy Army have their voices back. Green b Robinson 0(1)

Robinson to Warner, out Caught by Stokes!! What has he done here? He has chipped a slower delivery straight up in the air, Stokes dives forward and grabs a dolly. Has a big smile on his face - unable to believe that Warner has found him. Stays there laughing. The off-pace slower delivery from Robinson, off-cutter and totally does Warner in who is taken aback, is into the drive early and spoons a simple catch. Out for 94. England fighting back. Warner c Stokes b Robinson 94(176) [4s-11 6s-2]

Mark Wood to Smith, out Caught by Buttler!! Steve Smith goes. 147kph, short of length from wide of the crease, around the imaginary sixth-seventh stump line, Smith flirts and edges behind. So unlike Smith to be playing at those with a break around the corner. Well-deserved wicket for Mark Wood though. Respite for England. Smith c Buttler b Mark Wood 12(19) [4s-2]

Jack Leach to Labuschagne, out Caught by Mark Wood!! And he is gone. Cut straight to backward point. Marnus stands there unable to believe that he has found the fielder. A wicket totally against the run of play. Bit of extra bounce and Labuschagne fails to keep the cut down off the back foot, finds backward point. "Litte lack of respect for Jack Leach" says Mark Waugh on air. Relief for England. Labuschagne c Mark Wood b Jack Leach 74(117) [4s-6 6s-2]

Robinson to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Malan!! Edged and taken at third slip. Robinson with the breakthrough for England. 129kph, full across Marcus Harris who pushes with hard hands, the edge flies to the right of Malan and he snaffles it without any issues. Good low catch and that line across the batter working for Robinson even though Harris did not need to have played that. England needed that though. Marcus Harris c Malan b Robinson 3(17)

Green to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Hazlewood!! That's a terrific catch from Hazlewood to help Green get his maiden Test wicket. His mates are delighted for him. Short ball, Pope goes for the pull but gets a thick top-edge. It goes quite wide of Hazlewood at fine leg and he has to cover a lot of ground to his left. Once he's done that, it's still not enough. He then has to bring out a big dive. The ball is dying in front of him, it's pretty wide as well. But Hazlewood is full stretch, managing to get his hands under it. Absolutely brilliant. Ollie Pope c Hazlewood b Green 35(79) [4s-2]

Starc to Buttler, out Caught by Carey!! Starc breaks through! It's a lovely delivery to end Buttler's punchy resistance. Good length ball across off stump which is close enough to make Buttler play. Actually it pitched around middle stump and then deviated off the seam for the outside edge. Cracking delivery. Buttler c Carey b Starc 39(58) [4s-5]

Cummins to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Smith!! Edged and gone! Hameed's resistance is over. Cummins strikes in the first over after lunch. 138.5kph, Cummins bowls this fuller and draws the batter forward. Haseeb Hameed could have let it go on line, but the length forced him into a defensive stroke. The ball straightens ever so lightly to catch the outside edge and Smith gobbles it up at second slip moving to his left. England have lost half their side now! Haseeb Hameed c Smith b Cummins 25(75) [4s-3]

Cummins to Stokes, out Caught by Labuschagne!! First Ashes wicket as captain for Patty Cummins. Angled in on a short of length at the stumps, a hint of extra bounce, Stokes is opened up a little in defence on the back foot and the thick outside-edge carries nicely to the left of third slip where Marnus Labuschagne makes no mistake. Dream start for Australia just got better. Stokes shakes his head as he walks off. Didn't manage to keep it down and that's another good slip catch. Stokes c Labuschagne b Cummins 5(21) [4s-1]

Hazlewood to Root, out Caught by Warner!! And Root's gone too... Problems for England, plenty of problems. They've opted to bat, and are now finding themselves in tricky conditions and with the captain back in the hut. And with Hazlewood bowling beautifully. Full ball close to off, Root is forward in defence. The ball holds its line a touch, enough to miss the middle of the bat, and take the edge to first slip. Carries beautifully to Warner. Root c Warner b Hazlewood 0(9)

Hazlewood to Malan, out Caught by Carey!! Nicked to the keeper. Classic Hazlewood. Back of a length across off, keeping it in the channel, drawing the poke from Malan and maybe finding a bit of nip off the pitch for the edge. We're 20 balls in and England find themselves two down. Was definitely a delivery Malan could've left, especially with the bounce here. Malan c Carey b Hazlewood 6(9) [4s-1]

Starc to Rory Burns, out Bowled!! Oh he's knocked him over first ball. Starc roars and the crowd goes berserk. Burns has been bowled round his legs, wow! He shuffles across too far, Starc nails the blockhole on leg stump and Burns misses his flick. What a dramatic start this is. Rory Burns b Starc 0(1)
